user._instructions: Pixel padding for each side and radius for each corner. Values are independent by role. Surface profiles in this chat.json override chat_common. Missing values use built-in defaults; radius_px is an optional per-role all-corners fallback. line_height is a font-size multiplier or explicit CSS length; its default is 1.5 for either role.
